articles.summary: TORONTO, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Centerra Gold Inc. (“Centerra” or the “Company”) (TSX: CG) (NYSE: CGAU) announced today that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend of C$0.07 per common share, representing approximately C$13.6 million or US$9.5 million in aggregate. The quarterly dividend is payable on December 2, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 19, 2026.
